contentPattern.structure: tab label + card grid per row

suitableFor: category-filterable listings where each tab reveals a grid of cards
adventure/product/article grids grouped under labeled filter tabs
tab switchers whose panels each contain a responsive image-card grid (image + title link + description)
notSuitableFor: tab panels of long-form prose / detail copy (use tabs-detail)
a single ungrouped card grid with no filtering (use cards)
accordion-style stacked content that is all visible at once

distinctFrom.tabs: Vanilla local/collection 'tabs' styles panels for generic content. tabs-listing styles each panel as a responsive adventure-card grid (image on top, uppercase title link, description) and gives the tab bar the WKND uppercase active-dark-fill look.
distinctFrom.tabs-detail: tabs-detail panels render long-form justified prose (45px line-height, triangle-bullet lists) for a single adventure's Overview/Itinerary/What-to-Bring. tabs-listing panels render a grid of many adventure cards. Similarity scored ~0.47 (< 0.80 threshold) — new variant created.
distinctFrom.cards: A plain cards grid has no tab filtering. tabs-listing folds the card grid into a tab switcher so it stays one block (David's Model forbids nesting a cards block inside a tabs panel).
